emails.title: Help your customers plan a smarter mainframe refresh
emails.subject: Help your customers plan a smarter mainframe refresh
emails.body:
Many of your IBM Z customers are facing storage refresh deadlines. Now is the ideal time to help them step back and evaluate their options, not just renew what's in place.

See the full formatted email for resources and links.
